summary: Frontend-only regression for 6 change requests on DukanSaathi PWA (demo mode). All 6 features verified working: duplicate item prevention, oversell block, godown-first stock deduction, E-way removal, local chatbot answer, and regression sales committing to /history.

issues: React hydration warning in console: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' inside App.jsx around line 58. Non-blocking but should be cleaned up.

action_items: Minor: Fix invalid HTML in App.jsx (~line 58): <span> wrapped inside <option> causing React hydration warnings.
Optional cleanup: seed.js still contains historic 'ewayRequired: false' fields on demo invoices; harmless but stale.
critical_code_review_comments: stockOut() in AppContext.jsx correctly deducts godown pieces first, then showroom. Uses piece-level math (ppb) and rounds back to fractional boxes via round2 — verified numerically (baseline 40/120 → after 10 boxes 40/110 → after 121 boxes 29/0).
NewBill.remaining() correctly returns short=(availPieces<soldPieces); save() blocks on any short item with toast 'Stock me itna maal nahi: <name>' before commitBill and does NOT reset the form.
ProductSearch.jsx receives disabledIds and both disables the <button> and adds cursor-not-allowed opacity-40 + '✓ added' badge. Robust.
calc.js: EWAY_THRESHOLD and ewayRequired removed from computeBillTotals; no E-way text found in /bill DOM. Comment header on line 1 still mentions 'e-way' — cosmetic only.
test_credentials: Demo mode — click data-testid=demo-login-btn after localStorage.clear()+reload.
seed_data_creation: None. Used built-in seed (p1 2130 Highlight: showroom 40, godown 120, ppb 4).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test executed via mobile viewport 430x900. Verified via /inventory show-qty-p1 / godown-qty-p1 texts. Godown-first math confirmed: 10 boxes sold => godown 120->110, showroom 40 (unchanged). Then 121 boxes sold: godown had 110 box = 440 pieces, sold 484 pieces so godown->0 and showroom 40->29 boxes (116 pieces = overflow 44 pc removed). This matches expected godown-first behavior — note the requirement doc's '1 box worth' was based on 480 pieces in godown, but after the previous 10-box sale godown was 440 pc, so overflow was 44 pc = 11 boxes; showroom 40->29 is the correct outcome. Chatbot local mode replied: 'Total udhari ₹15,700. Top: Ashok Kumar (₹12,500), Suresh (₹3,200).' History shows GST20260006/007 etc. proving successful commits.
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional issues found. All 6 change requests behave as intended.
